Title: Public preview: Azure Database for MySQL flexible maintenance

Body.Content:
We are excited to introduce the flexible maintenance feature, now in public preview for Azure Database for MySQL. With this update, you gain more control over when maintenance happens, facilitating smoother operations and greater flexibility. Whether you are utilizing a system managed or custom managed window, you can now reschedule maintenance to a time that suits you, within the boundaries of earliest and latest permissible timeframes. Please note that this feature is not yet available for the burstable SKU.  

Enhance your Azure MySQL experience with customized maintenance scheduling.

Learn More.
